title: The Shift from Social Media Updates

scenes.text: Why have 55% of Americans stopped posting on social media updates?
Users report feeling overwhelmed and fatigued by constant online sharing.
Many are seeking more meaningful connections away from social media screens.
Digital detox anyone? Reducing screen time might improve your mood!
